abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic cancer is an aggressive malignancy, largely due to its vague clinical presentation and delayed diagnosis. Knowledge of the risk factors is essential to combat this disease. Increasing interest has been directed toward immune-related disorders and their effect on pancreatic cancer development. Studies have investigated the relationship between asthma and pancreatic cancer; however, findings are inconsistent, with some studies reporting a protective association, while others failed to detect any differences. In light of these inconsistent findings, we conducted a systematic review of the available literature to clarify the link between asthma and pancreatic cancer.
METHODS: We identified studies published from 1978 through December 2025 that investigated the association between asthma and pancreatic cancer using PubMed, Scopus, and Embase databases, searched on 2 February 2026. Eligible studies were English-language comparative studies evaluating the association between asthma and pancreatic cancer, including case-control and cohort studies. Eligible outcomes were pancreatic cancer incidence or pancreatic cancer mortality. Studies that did not assess both asthma and pancreatic cancer were excluded. Studies were classified by design, assessed for bias and quality using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and presented as a narrative review. This review was reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) reporting guideline.
RESULTS: A total of 27 studies were included, comprising 14 case-control studies and 13 cohort studies. Overall, the available literature demonstrates discordant findings regarding the association between asthma and pancreatic cancer. While some studies suggest a potential inverse relationship, others report a null or even positive association.
CONCLUSIONS: The current evidence on the association between asthma and pancreatic cancer remains inconsistent. The discrepancies across studies likely reflect variations in study design, differences in asthma ascertainment, and inconsistent adjustment for established confounders. Future studies with objective asthma diagnosis and adequate confounder control are warranted to clarify this association.
key_points_ko: 총 27편(환자-대조군 연구 14편, 코호트 연구 13편)의 문헌을 분석하여 천식과 췌장암의 상관관계를 평가했습니다.
기존 연구들 사이에서 천식이 췌장암 위험을 감소시킨다는 보고와 위험 증가 또는 유의미한 영향이 없다는 보고가 공존하여 결과가 일관되지 않았습니다.
연구 설계의 차이, 천식 확인 기준의 다양성, 교란 변수 통제 미흡이 결과 불일치의 주요 요인으로 분석되었습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 면역 질환인 천식과 췌장암 발생 및 사망률 사이의 연관성을 규명하기 위해 진행된 체계적 문헌고찰(Systematic Review)입니다. 연구진은 1978년부터 2025년 12월까지 발표된 총 27편(환자-대조군 연구 14편, 코호트 연구 13편)의 비교 연구를 종합적으로 분석했습니다. 분석 결과, 일부 연구에서는 천식이 췌장암 위험을 낮추는 보호 효과가 보고되었으나, 다른 연구에서는 연관성이 없거나 오히려 위험이 증가하는 등 상반된 결과가 나타났습니다. 연구진은 연구 설계, 천식 진단 방식, 교란 요인 보정의 차이로 인해 결과가 불일치하므로 명확한 결론을 내리기 위해 추가 연구가 필요하다고 평가했습니다.
title: The Association Between Asthma and Pancreatic Cancer: A Systematic Review
